name: depict
description: An Agent Skill that explains a concept by drawing it: a hand-drawn board that builds stroke by stroke and stays explorable.
author: David Estévez

scripts.examples: for b in skills/depict/examples/*/board.mjs; do node skills/depict/scripts/build.mjs "$b" --out "${b%board.mjs}$(basename "$(dirname "$b")").html" --audit || exit 1; done
scripts.characters: for c in marker stuart; do node skills/depict/scripts/character.mjs $c --out skills/depict/examples/characters/$c || exit 1; done
scripts.looks: for c in stuart skills/depict/examples/friends/pip.mjs skills/depict/examples/friends/pencil.mjs; do node skills/depict/scripts/look.mjs $c --out skills/depict/examples/friends/$(basename $c .mjs).look.js || exit 1; done
